sources.name: Database of Political Institutions 2023
sources.role: The spine. Codes the chief executive's party as left, right or centre.

sources.name: V-Party v2
sources.licence: Free for academic and non-commercial use, citation required
sources.role: Expert-coded party positions. Fills country-years DPI leaves blank, and supplies the seven-point spectrum on its own.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.role: Property P1387, political alignment, joined to dated terms of office. This is what extends the series past DPI's 2023 end.

sources.name: Regimes of the World
sources.publisher: V-Dem, via Our World in Data
sources.role: Closed and electoral autocracies, electoral and liberal democracies.

sources.name: Population
sources.publisher: Our World in Data, from the UN World Population Prospects
sources.role: Every weight in the population view, taken per country and per year.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.publisher: Natural Earth, via the natural-earth-vector repository
sources.role: Map geometry, projected at build time into plain SVG paths.

sources.name: Hand-coded rows
sources.role: My own coding, each row carrying a written basis and a verification date. Checked against DPI by scripts/audit_hand_coded.py so it cannot silently contradict the spine.

meta.note: no_reading means nothing places the government on the left-right axis: an absolute monarchy, a military government, or a party organised around one leader rather than a set of policies. unresolved means we lack data. They are different claims and are never merged. Each year reports which source resolved it.

dpi.label: DPI
dpi.note: Database of Political Institutions. Codes the chief executive's party as left, right or centre. Covers 1975 to 2023.

vparty.label: V-Party
vparty.note: V-Party, an expert survey of party positions from the V-Dem Institute. Fills country-years DPI leaves blank. Ends around 2019.

carry_forward.label: Carry-forward
carry_forward.note: V-Party's rating of a party, reapplied to later years where DPI still records that same party in power.

dpi_carried.label: DPI, carried
dpi_carried.note: DPI's own reading of a government that was still in office after DPI stopped reporting. Used in place of a later source that judges the same unchanged government differently.

hand.label: Hand-coded
hand.note: Coded here, with a written basis and a verification date for every row.

wikidata.label: Wikidata
wikidata.note: Wikidata's political alignment property, joined to dated head-of-government terms. This is what extends the series past 2023.

no_reading.label: Doesn't apply
no_reading.note: Nothing places this government on the left-right axis: an absolute monarchy, a military government, or a party organised around one leader rather than a set of policies.

unresolved.label: No data
unresolved.note: No source places this country-year on the left-right axis.

closed_autocracy.label: Closed autocracy
closed_autocracy.note: No multiparty elections for the chief executive or the legislature.

electoral_autocracy.label: Electoral autocracy
electoral_autocracy.note: Multiparty elections are held, but they fall short of free and fair.

electoral_democracy.label: Electoral democracy
electoral_democracy.note: Meaningful, free and fair multiparty elections.

liberal_democracy.label: Liberal democracy
liberal_democracy.note: Free and fair elections, plus individual and minority rights, equality before the law and real checks on the executive.

unknown.label: Regime not classified
unknown.note: V-Dem does not classify this country-year.

palette.note: colour is the light-theme value. colour_dark, where present, replaces it under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

world.label: All countries
world.note: Everything the source data covers. Default view.

g20.label: G20
g20.note: Excludes the EU and African Union bloc seats, which have no single government.

brics.label: BRICS+
brics.note: Founding five plus the 2024 expansion, plus Indonesia (Jan 2025). Saudi Arabia was invited but has not formally acceded — excluded.

asean.label: ASEAN
asean.note: Timor-Leste acceded as the 11th member in October 2025.

africa.label: Africa
africa.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

asia.label: Asia
asia.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

europe.label: Europe
europe.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

north_america.label: North America
north_america.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

south_america.label: South America
south_america.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

oceania.label: Oceania
oceania.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

african_union.label: African Union
african_union.note: Excludes Western Sahara, which has no OWID population series in this build.

anglosphere.label: Anglosphere
anglosphere.note: Six English-speaking democracies with closely related party systems.
